smell_validity.evidence: Title and ID are one document identity: the ID is derived from the title at parse time and both feed anchors, CompoundID and search slugs. The injection re-plumbs that record into parallel strings across frontmatter, fs and fts; Meta() literally rebuilds the record via metaFromIdentity on every call, and fts.identityFor duplicates the ID-falls-back-to-title rule. The fault is unmistakable without the label.

maintenance_impact.evidence: The defaulting rule now lives in frontmatter.applyIdentityDefaults and fts.identityFor; they drift independently unless kept in agreement, and metaFromIdentity's both-empty-to-nil signal is an implicit cross-package contract that renderers depend on. Adding any metadata field (the prompt's Locale) requires editing signatures in all three packages, so restoring one identity owner removes a lasting trap, though in a small codebase.

development_plausibility.evidence: The change reads like a believable half-finished decoupling pass: idiomatic small constructors, reuse of slug and normalizeCompoundID, and the natural removal of the reflect-based isEntityNil when walking typed Parent fields. The Meta() shim keeps parts/cmd compiling, matching real abandoned refactors. The stated rationale is undercut by fs still importing frontmatter, which exposes the hinge slightly.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt pins scope (packages that parse, store, index identity), the finished state (identity owned once, handed as a unit), and explicitly requires removing the duplicated fallback, preventing partial cleanup. It freezes every observable surface — parsing results, walk errors, compound identifiers, search index, external Entity consumers — preventing redesign, while leaving the owning type open. Wrong direction and incomplete cleanup are materially blocked.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Distinct stages: parse-time finalization (empty ID defaults then slugifies), node storage that must keep the both-empty-to-nil signal for renderers, hierarchy ID traversal over typed parent fields, and index-time slug derivation whose fallback differs observably (identityFor returns the raw title, never slugified). Each needs a different code-supported decision; one fallback rule cannot serve both slugifying and non-slugifying call sites.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names the three pipeline areas, but deciding whether fts.identityFor must change requires combining fs's storage shape with frontmatter's defaulting, and deciding whether the Meta() shim and Entity interface stay requires inspecting parts/cmd consumers. The content/sideNotes/hasSideNotes triplet in makeSection and processSectionWords looks like the same unwrap but must be excluded. No aliases, registration or config selection raise it further.

repair_coordination.evidence: Two rules interact: the identity representation choice simultaneously determines metaFromIdentity's nil signal (the external Meta() contract) and the nil-tolerant parent walks in CompoundID and slugifySectionName that currently append empty IDs; unifying the fallback must preserve parse-time slugification versus the index's raw title. Changing only fs or only fts leaves anchors and search slugs inconsistent.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: The best supported uniform rule — reintroduce one identity value (the still-imported *frontmatter.Meta) on nodes and thread it through fields, constructors, walk and signatures — mechanically covers roughly two-thirds or more of sites with compiler guidance. The residue needs behavioral decisions: nil-guarding parent traversal in two CompoundID implementations and deduplicating identityFor without slugifying the index fallback, so the 80 percent threshold is not met.

behavioral_risk.evidence: A specific wrong edit — dropping the both-empty-to-nil signal, or restoring the old Metadata.ID walk — passes for ordinary documents whose sections all carry frontmatter, but identity-less inline-content sections built via makeSection with empty strings, and frontmatter-less groups, reach changed rendering, silently altered search slugs, or a nil dereference. The supplied material shows no test records, so higher levels cannot be established.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
